3.  24-54602  Recommendation to discuss the Mayor’s Fund utility bill options outside of the
  envelopes.

  A motion was made by Member Rew, seconded by Member Lewis, to approve
  recommendation. The motion carried by the following vote:

  Yes:  3  Howat, Rew, Lewis
  No:  0  None
  Recused: 0  None
  Abstain: 0  None
  Absent: 0  None

  • The utilities office provided the measurements for the Utility bill flyer.
  • The Subcommittee will be work on drafting a flyer that will be reviewed
  during the September meeting.
  • There was discussion on postcard design and fundraising. The
  subcommittee is considering a local newspaper to add a story on the
  Mayor’s Fund.
  • City staff suggested that the mayor emphasize a different organization
  supported by the Mayor’s Fund.
  • No public comment.

5.  24-54600  Recommendation to discuss and approve the Mayor’s Fund Application Review-
  Prep ED Programs Inc.

  A motion was made by Member Rew, seconded by Member Lewis, to approve
  recommendation. The motion carried by the following vote:

  Yes:  3  Howat, Rew, Lewis
  No:  0  None
  Recused: 0  None
  Abstain: 0  None
  Absent: 0  None

  • Applicant Claude Jr. and Claude Sr. were present and ready to address
  questions. The subcommittee inquired about sustainability and the strategy
  for maintaining services beyond the initial three months. Claude Jr.
  answered these questions.
  • Claude Jr. responded to further questions from the subcommittee and
  provided a brief overview of his organization’s activities, emphasizing their
  commitment to community service.
  • Members of the committee moved to approve the item and present it at the
  HSAC meeting on 9-4-24 for a final vote to approve.
  • Public comment, concerning the standardization of awards, the committee
  appears to seek a level of compliance that aligns more with state and federal
  requirements for larger funding amounts. It’s important for the committee to
  recognize the type and amount of low-barrier funds they oversee, ensuring
  that equity and equality remain priorities in their decisions.

6.  24-54604  Recommendation to discuss and approve the Mayor’s Fund Application Review-
  (PATH) Family Commons Youth Program.

  A motion was made by Member Rew, seconded by Member Lewis, to approve
  recommendation. The motion carried by the following vote:

  Yes:  3  Howat, Rew, Lewis
  No:  0  None
  Recused: 0  None
  Abstain: 0  None
  Absent: 0  None

  • The subcommittee and staff had concerns around the application and the

  mayor’s fund is meant to help support smaller CBO’s.
  • The subcommittee declined the application because it did not meet the
  grant’s funding requirements, specifically regarding sustainability.
  • No public comment.

7.  24-54605  Recommendation to discuss and approve future agenda items.

  A motion was made by Member Rew, seconded by Member Lewis, to approve

  Yes:  3  Howat, Rew, Lewis

  Absent: 0  None

  • Members will work on drafting the Utility bill flyer, standard operating

  organization. Items will be reviewed at the next subcommittee meeting.
  • No public comment.
